description: Turn a finished search into a watch: portal searches per postcode district, filters, a state file path for de-duplication and a ready prompt for a scheduled task in the user's Claude that reports only new listings. Stateless: nothing is stored on Close Knit.

frequency.description: [option] How often the scheduled check runs.
frequency.title: Frequency

market.description: [option] Homes for sale (buy) or to let (rent).
market.title: Market

min_bedrooms.description: [input value] Fewest bedrooms (0 = studio or any).
min_bedrooms.title: Min Bedrooms

must_haves.description: [input value] Free-text requirements the agent checks per listing (a list is joined with '; ').
must_haves.title: Must Haves

property_type.description: [option] Home type for the portal filters (house, flat, bungalow or any).
property_type.title: Property Type

name: build_watch_spec
title: Build watch spec
